title: Stanley Druckenmiller
html: Who: Ran Duquesne Capital for ~30 years famously without a losing year; co-led the 1992 bet against the British pound with George Soros. Core ideas: Liquidity and the Fed drive markets, not just earnings; preserve capital, then bet big when conviction is high; change your mind fast when wrong. For our plan: Treat Fed decisions (next: Oct 28) as a major input. Our weekly report's Fed section is "Druck's corner." Back to Council of Masters
